connector.name: Frappe MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Interact with Frappe/ERPNext sites - document CRUD, search, and whitelisted method calls
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package frappe-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the muthanii account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FRAPPE_URL
env.description: Base URL of your Frappe/ERPNext site, e.g. https://your-site.erpnext.com

env.name: FRAPPE_API_KEY
env.description: Frappe API key for token-based authentication

env.name: FRAPPE_API_SECRET
env.description: Frappe API secret paired with the API key

env.name: FRAPPE_VERIFY_SSL
env.description: Set to 'false' to skip TLS certificate verification. Defaults to 'true'.

env.name: FRAPPE_TIMEOUT
env.description: Per-request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.
